brief.zh: 顺序完成所有工段。times[i] 是第 i 段在 A、B 两线各自的工时。switches[i] 是从第 i 段进入第 i+1 段时 [A 转 B, B 转 A] 的额外耗时。第一段任选线，留在原线换轨耗时为 0。返回 [最短总工时, 达到最短工时的最少换线次数]。空工单返回 [0, 0]。
brief.en: Complete every stage in order. times[i] contains [time on A, time on B] at stage i. switches[i] holds the extra [A to B, B to A] transfer times between stages i and i+1. Start on either line. Staying on a line costs no transfer time. Return [minimum total time, fewest transfers among schedules at that time]. An empty job returns [0, 0].

solutionCode:
def line_schedule(times, switches):
    if len(times) == 0:
        return [0, 0]
    previous = [[times[0][0], 0], [times[0][1], 0]]
    for i in range(1, len(times)):
        current = []
        for line in range(2):
            other = 1 - line
            time = previous[line][0]
            count = previous[line][1]
            transfer = previous[other][0] + switches[i - 1][other]
            changes = previous[other][1] + 1
            if transfer < time or (transfer == time and changes < count):
                time = transfer
                count = changes
            current.append([time + times[i][line], count])
        previous = current
    a = previous[0]
    b = previous[1]
    if b[0] < a[0] or (b[0] == a[0] and b[1] < a[1]):
        return b
    return a
